steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You're not gonna help?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You aren't rising from your seat either.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I'm not needed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Strictly speaking, I'm still a prisoner of Iberia. It is not my place to worry for a High Inquisitor.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's talk about the two of us.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We'll stay in this town on the coastline, for a while.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We know how to follow stage directions. If you and your Abyssal Hunters fail, we'll take the Iberians and pull back to an appropriate position.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Assuming the old man outside listens to us, anyway.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...You're willing to help the people on the land.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Frost is young, I'm about the same age as Dan, and Aya maybe a little older.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: There's little left for us to love, except... music.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Frailty of body and mind has driven humans to seek breakthroughs within their short lifespans.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: And what do you know, they pulled it off.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Indeed.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But the sea's not a fan of heavy metal.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: We don't have a choice. As far as survival is concerned, the land is the lesser evil.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would not be difficult to get this country to listen. Reveal a few secrets, hint at old wounds, and promise that the same disaster will not strike again.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Can it really be that easy?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even simpler, if promises can be considered lies.

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: Monsters! Monsters!

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: Where's the Inquisition?! Anyone?! Help!

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: Grr... grr...

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: As ever, Kal'tsit picks the worst meeting locations.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What's going on here?

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: T-Thank you... A-Are you an Ægir too? From the outside?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ah, you refer to AUS. Ægir, eh...

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: A-Are you here to fight them? You took out those monsters in the blink of an eye...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Your attitude towards the Ægir seems different in this town.

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: There used to be a lot of them around here, until about twenty years ago.

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: Did the Inquisition send you? Sh-Should we ask for their help?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: None of my concern.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But unless you intend to get hurt, I recommended hiding until this is over.

steps.name: Panicking Townsfolk
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This place, they're everywhere.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Not as bad as Sal Viento, but it's still strange.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This town has not been consumed by rot. There are even those leading more or less normal lives here.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The waves have not touched this place.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Then the flotsam has gone into hiding.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: No surprise there. If our target is that ship, then Kal'tsit must have chosen this place for a reason.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Should we split up?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I'll find Kal'tsit. You and Shark handle the Sea Terrors.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: They are weak, but don't get hurt. Weakness is often bait.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...Shark?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Take care of her, Skadi. I still have trouble getting used to how she is now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Fleeing Townsfolk
steps.text: Monsters?! Where did they come from?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: This way!

steps.name: Fleeing Townsfolk
steps.text: Oh, er, right!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: They're relatively few in number, but surprisingly coordinated. Is someone leading them?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: And how could they have just popped up out of nowhere? Where are they hiding?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is it... this way?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Getting closer... there's someone here!)

steps.name: Mournful Adherent
steps.text: One falls, another takes their place. We give our lives only to buy time.

steps.name: Mournful Adherent
steps.text: No one here can stand against a High Inquisitor. All who resist are doomed.

steps.name: Silent Cultist
steps.text: In death lies hope. Do not squander it.

steps.name: Mournful Adherent
steps.text: Yes... we must hasten our departure. But it is a shame to abandon the closest outpost we have to the Eye of Iberia...

steps.name: Mournful Adherent
steps.text: We need but one to reach the Eye... Who goes there?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Crap!)

steps.name: Mournful Adherent
steps.text: Liberi! Don't let him get away!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Gran Faro will be no more. Is this really what you want?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Our interests are aligned. This shouldn't have to happen.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You're the only one who can stop the both the Inquisition and your own people.

steps.name: Bizarre Hunter
steps.text: I'll kill you, Amaia. Soon.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: My, my... I thought we were on a first-name basis, Ulpianus.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Perhaps you intended to make your move once we'd arrived at the lighthouse? But you know full well that's not our destination.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: We're going someplace further, and it's there that we'll make our choice.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Aren't the Abyssal Hunters all of one mind? Why haven't you gone back to your squad?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You never saw what I saw.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Ah, yes... the oldest story in the book. They never saw what you saw, either.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Did you lose trust in each other?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Ægir is united by the bonds of blood.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I chose to go into exile in order to achieve our common goal.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Uh huh...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Stay away from them, Amaia.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Even on dry land, Gladiia, Skadi and Laurentina can wipe this town from existence with little more than a shrug.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Hmph.
The hand that Amaia has placed on the book moves ever so slightly.
Unperturbed, she smiles back at the provocation.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You're right. Thank you for your concern.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I need that ship.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I must reach it before Gladiia. They cannot return to Ægir knowing nothing of what's going on.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Finally shook them off!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: How can they be hiding this many people? Is this town some kind of clown car?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: There's nothing but barrens to the north.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So where are they coming from?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: A pleasure to meet you, ma'am.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You must be the Abyssal Hunter that Kal'tsit mentioned.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Is this your work?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Iberia is not always so messy. I beg your pardon.
Gladiia is quiet for a moment.
In her long years on dry land, she has seen how weak and backwards the terrestrial states are, but also the strength of the Inquisitors at Sal Viento.
Kal'tsit's words echo in her mind as she thinks on how to live alongside those above water.
The silence lasts only a moment.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I am Gladiia, Technology Consul of Ægir, and the Abyssal Hunters' Chief Designer of Warfare.
For the first time, she speaks to a land-dweller as a representative of Ægir.
Her counterpart nods, sheathes his rapier, and strides over the silent carcass of the Sea Terror.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Carmen, High Inquisitor of the Iberian Inquisition. I see the legends of Ægir hold true.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: You're different from the others.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I have a few more years under my belt.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Where's Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: She's speaking to another guest from the ocean in the chapel.
Gladiia turns to walk away when—

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: If you've come to speak to the doctor, I'm sure she's shared the same information with you.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...Perhaps.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: What do you think of her suggestion?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We can talk after I've confirmed she's unharmed.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We have no reason to harm someone who wishes to protect Iberia from the bottom of her heart.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: So you say.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I've seen more foolishness in my brief time on land than I have for half a lifetime.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: If it's been such a brief time, how can you be so sure?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The worst of times brings out the worst in people. Iberia's current reality is far from gilded.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Regardless, I'm not here to debate.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If she's in the chapel behind you, then—

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You'll never reach the Eye of Iberia without the Inquisition's help.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: It was not destroyed in the Profound Silence. If the Stultifera remains afloat, then the Eye of Iberia is the only way to find it in the vastness of the ocean.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: What Iberia can offer, I can achieve on my own with only slightly more effort.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I suppose I have something to look forward to then, Gladiia.

steps.name: Vigilant Cultist
steps.text: How many left?

steps.name: Agitated Cultist
steps.text: Four or five, maybe. Some have departed to seek sanctuary elsewhere.

steps.name: Vigilant Cultist
steps.text: Very well. Burn these documents. We don't have time for them.

steps.name: Agitated Cultist
steps.text: Gran Faro... I once called this place home.

steps.name: Vigilant Cultist
steps.text: You are still bound by such distractions?

steps.name: Agitated Cultist
steps.text: No... no more. Burn them all.

steps.name: Vigilant Cultist
steps.text: The Inquisition must not find them.

steps.name: Vigilant Cultist
steps.text: We embrace this knowledge, and promote harmony through enlightenment. The Inquisition, in their ignorance and selfishness, calls it heresy.

steps.name: Agitated Cultist
steps.text: Let's go. We will find a way to reestablish contact.

steps.name: Agitated Cultist
steps.text: We too will embrace the ocean, someday.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (Are they gone? Is this one of their hideouts? And here I thought it was just a struggling restaurant. It's only two blocks from the chapel, for crying out loud.)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (They're burning their papers? I have to put the fire out!)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (The flames are too strong. I have to save what I can—)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yowch, that's hot!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Whew... are these blueprints? Some sort of equipment...? The stamp of approval has been burned to ash.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Historical records of Iberia... theses on ocean currents...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: What are they planning? Breo... gan? Royal shipwright?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: And what's this? A drawing of that statue in the square?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Put that down, Liberi. Let it burn as it should.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You—
Elysium has always been confident in his ability to talk his way out of a situation.
In this case, however, he does not get a chance to, barely avoiding the touch of cold steel.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, don't you know it's rude to strike without warning?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit! Their goal is—
